capabilities: Insert video thumbnails from clipboard URLs
Create links titled with the video's title
Render thumbnails via a vid code block
Show title and channel for offline thumbnails
extras: Offline behavior is configurable: thumbnails can keep title and channel when offline, and images can optionally be saved to a user-specified local location.
problem: Video links in notes are plain URLs, so it is hard to see at a glance which video a link points to.
summary: Video thumbnail plugin that inserts YouTube and Vimeo thumbnails into notes via code blocks and clipboard commands.
